purpose: Acquire and no-return screen one government-subsidy announcement count-and-freshness factor for the fixed three-local-session A-share protocol without announcement-body text, subsidy amounts, financial denominators, credentials, price access, or return access.

provider_contract.recursive_bisection: After fetching only page one, bisect an inclusive date range into two non-overlapping inclusive calendar ranges before requesting later pages when ceil(total_hits / 100) exceeds 80. A single calendar date above 80 pages is fatal.
provider_contract.transport_attempt_policy: Sequential requests. A page may be attempted at most three times only for timeout, connection, HTTP 429/5xx, or JSON-decoding failure. Schema, identity, title, pagination, count, or content failures are never retried or skipped.

identity_and_schema_policy.art_code: NFKC-trimmed nonempty scalar string used only in memory for identity and discarded before publication
identity_and_schema_policy.notice_date: strict ISO-like calendar date parsed without coercion and required to lie inside the inclusive leaf partition
identity_and_schema_policy.codes: nonempty list of objects; supported A-share candidates require ann_type beginning with A and a complete six-digit stock_code
identity_and_schema_policy.unsupported_complete_code_policy: Exclude and count BSE, STAR, funds, bonds, and every other complete non-holding code. They never enter source or factor coverage denominators.
identity_and_schema_policy.multiple_supported_codes_policy: Exactly one supported A-share code must remain in a record. Zero supported codes is an excluded non-target row; two or more supported codes is fatal ambiguity.
identity_and_schema_policy.columns: nonempty list of complete objects retained only as transport-structure evidence and never used for semantic relabeling or persistence
identity_and_schema_policy.duplicate_policy: Any duplicate source key inside or across accepted partitions is fatal; never silently deduplicate.
identity_and_schema_policy.extra_record_fields: Allowed but ignored and forbidden from persistence. A missing required record field is fatal.
identity_and_schema_policy.pagination_consistency: Every page in one leaf partition must report the same nonnegative integer total_hits; received list length must be from 1 through 100 except a final page may be shorter; concatenated received rows must equal total_hits exactly; no page is skipped or fetched twice.
identity_and_schema_policy.empty_leaf_policy: A leaf with total_hits zero must return an empty list and is count-complete. A whole frozen Q1 acceptance window with zero source rows is fatal.

title_classification.normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim leading and trailing whitespace, collapse every internal Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space
title_classification.match_rule: A normalized title qualifies if and only if it contains at least one required literal and contains none of the excluded literals.
title_classification.nonmatching_title_policy: Exclude and count. A nonmatch is not evidence that the issuer received no subsidy outside this contracted public category.

event_and_factor_definition.source_event_measure: government_subsidy_announcement_count = number of globally unique qualifying art_code values for one instrument and announcement_date
event_and_factor_definition.multiple_event_dates: Use only the latest qualifying announcement_date whose strict-next-session effective date is on or before the target session. A later effective event supersedes an older event.
event_and_factor_definition.valid_factor: finite and strictly positive; calendar age is an integer from 1 through 3 inclusive under the strict-next-session rule
event_and_factor_definition.invalid_policy: Exclude and count without clipping, filling, winsorizing, taking an absolute value, changing sign, substituting a title, summing older event dates, or extending age.
event_and_factor_definition.absent_event_policy: missing; never zero support or a favorable score

point_in_time_policy.conservative_availability: first local trading session strictly after announcement_date
point_in_time_policy.weekend_or_holiday_notice: Map to the first local trading session strictly after the calendar announcement date; the age remains calendar days and can expire immediately after a long closure.
point_in_time_policy.entry_if_later_admitted: next local session open after the signal-close ranking
point_in_time_policy.revision_policy: The public endpoint is a current historical announcement index without immutable correction versions. Correction, supplement, revision, progress, cancellation, and withdrawal titles are excluded by the frozen rule; duplicate identities or count changes reject the source rather than selecting a latest version.
point_in_time_policy.residual_limitation: notice_date has no verified intraday publication timestamp and the current public history can add, remove, or recategorize records. Waiting to the next session prevents same-date trading but cannot reconstruct a removed historical title.

acceptance_protocol.initial_partitioning: nine non-overlapping calendar months across the three fixed Q1 windows; recursive bisection follows the provider contract before later pages
acceptance_protocol.candidate_cross_section_definition: one local session after strict-next-session availability and the three-calendar-day latest-event rule, point-in-time holding-universe filtering, at least six distinct instruments, and at least two distinct finite factor values
required_checks: the mechanism audit, contract, holding universe, calendar, quarterly quality, accepted price-basis context, frontier, terminal record, and both execution policies match before network access

only the frozen public endpoint, category, parameters, dates, page ceiling, retry policy, and title literals are used; no Token, credential, cookie, proxy, retail session, or announcement body is accessed
all nine initial months and every recursive leaf reconcile their stable total_hits and received rows exactly, with no skipped or duplicate page
every required transport field is complete and structurally valid; complete unsupported-board records and nonmatching titles are excluded and counted, while ambiguous or malformed records abort
every instrument/announcement_date/art_code source key is globally unique before aggregation and every published event key is unique afterward
point-in-time holding-universe filtering and strict-next-session calendar mapping occur before sample variation checks
the latest-event age-weighted factor formula reproduces exactly in memory, remains finite and positive, and never uses an event older than three calendar days
each Q1 window and the combined samples pass the frozen source-row, qualifying-event, cross-section, name, and value-variation thresholds
the published frame contains only four normalized columns; title, art_code, codes, columns, names, bodies, URLs, amounts, financials, prices, returns, and credentials are absent
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: Write one terminal no-return source rejection, delete the hidden partial snapshot, publish no Parquet, and stop without another window, title rule, category, provider, field, aggregation, formula, direction, age, threshold, full sync, comparison, price, return, score, selection, sizing, or order.
acceptance_protocol.one_shot_policy: The exact acceptance may publish at most one success or rejection manifest. Once a provider request is issued, a schema/content/gate failure consumes the attempt. Every clone must reject a second attempt from the tracked result before loading this contract or issuing a request.

full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.recursive_bisection: same count-complete leaf rule and eighty-page ceiling as acceptance
full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.failure_policy: Delete the complete temporary snapshot, publish no final partition, write one terminal no-return source record, and stop without retry or price access.

capacity_contract_after_full_source_only.quality_gate: ROE at least 5 percent, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY with maximum age 550 calendar days
capacity_contract_after_full_source_only.capacity_failure_policy: Stop the exact mechanism permanently without loading comparisons, prices, or returns and without changing the title rule, age, samples, universe, quality, listing, name, value, cohort, or year gate.

uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.semantic_gate: Every sparse neighbor receives an explicit mechanism comparison and source-overlap count before price access. A generic announcement-count or generic freshness clone is rejected even when pairwise data are sparse.
uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.statistical_gate_for_sparse_neighbor: When at least 100 eligible pairwise sessions contain at least 6 pairwise names, require absolute median daily Spearman rank correlation below 0.8. Otherwise report overlap and descriptive correlation without treating sparse absence as uniqueness proof.
uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.dense_gate: Each dense confounder must provide at least 100 eligible pairwise sessions with at least 50 names and absolute median daily Spearman rank correlation below 0.8.
uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.anti_cherry_pick: The comparison catalog, overlap policy, thresholds, title literals, formula, direction, age, universe, and quality rule cannot change after any announcement row, title, or factor value is observed.

prohibited_actions: change or expand the title literals, use fuzzy or semantic classification, inspect bodies, request subsidy amounts, or add another announcement category after observing rows
persist titles, identities, codes arrays, column metadata, names, bodies, URLs, amounts, financial fields, prices, returns, credentials, cookies, proxies, or retail sessions
treat absence or a nonmatching title as zero, an all-market value, a favorable value, or proof of no subsidy
silently deduplicate, skip a page, accept changing totals, keep partial output, mix providers, invert the factor, sum superseded event dates, or widen the age
lower acceptance, capacity, uniqueness, quality, listing, name, value, cohort, or year gates after results
read prices or returns, aggregate, current-score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 before every separately frozen gate passes
